title: First singing and piano lessons in Houston
summary: Wallace has sung since childhood in church and played piano from about age eight, taught by her brother; her parents were not musical.

story.theme_name: Growing up and learning music: family, first instruments, teachers
story.community_name: Where I came from: parents, siblings and birth

blocks.x: -- remember when you first started singing?

I have been singing all my life, ever since I can remember. We sang at home in Houston, Texas, in church. And I'm 80 years old, so I've been singing 80 years back, I was in the church. I started off singing in the church.
When I was real little. When I was seven years old (unintelligible). I was already going to Sunday school.
And you remember when you first started playing the piano?
Played piano all my life. (Unintelligible). My whole family is musical. My brother made me take my first music lesson (unintelligible). He gave me my first music lesson.
Do you remember how old you were?
Eight. And how old was he at that time?
Well, he was married, (inaudible) he must have been up in the 20's because he was married.
Did your mother play any instruments?
No, my mother never played. I don't know where we picked this up at because mama didn't play and papa didn't either. I don't know where we got the music from.
I don't know where we got that music from because mama didn't play and neither sing, no more than in church.
So you got it in the church, you think?
